title: 第1章 嫂子，让我来
slug: 乱世武道从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“小叔，小叔。”

“起来喝点稀粥吧。”

轻柔的女声，唤醒了沉睡中的陆林。

嗓子干得像要冒烟。

陆林挣扎着睁开眼睛。

在昏暗的房间内，一位穿着粗布麻裙的女子，正坐在床边，手里端着一个老瓷大碗。

陆林看不清她的面容，下意识张嘴，一勺稀粥顺着喉咙流下，让他的身体意识逐渐恢复。

这是哪。

陆林记得昨天偶遇前女友，两人简单吃了点东西，就进了酒店。

干柴烈火。

折腾到后半夜两人才睡下。

怎么一觉醒来……

一股信息出现在陆林脑海之中。

大夏国，平北郡。

原身也叫陆林，才刚过十七岁。

前天饿极了，原身一个人进山想要猎点肉食，结果在山里迷路，硬生生冻了一夜，这才被路过的猎户搭救下山。

感染风寒，在床上静卧两天，一命呜呼，这才有陆林鹊占鸠巢。

给她喂粥的女子，是大嫂梁心兰。

家中还有个大哥，陆杨。

说起陆杨，陆林顿时感受到来自原身的一肚子怨气。

这家伙整天无所事事，不是喝酒，就是赌钱，赌钱输了，回到家里就暴打家人。

大嫂梁心兰和原身都是受害者。

原本还算富裕的家庭，这几年被陆杨整得乌烟瘴气，连勉强维持都困难。

眼下正值腊月，天寒地冻，可陆林家里连二斤粗粮都找不到。

偏偏那禽兽，还心安理得地出去找人赌钱。

“大嫂，我自己来就行。”

喝了两口稀粥，陆林感觉身体好了不少，就想自己喝粥。

“不行，你身子骨还弱，不要乱动，让大嫂来喂你。”

梁心兰的声音软软糯糯。

说是拒绝，但听起来跟撒娇差不多。

这时候，陆林的眼睛适应了房间内的光线。

当他看到梁心兰的面容时，忍不住心中一惊。

太像了。

梁心兰的模样，气质，跟陆林的前女友简直一模一样。

看到这一张脸，陆林就忍不住想起昨夜的经历。

一股热血直冲脑门。

“没事，我可以的。”

陆林猛地起身，一把抓住老瓷碗，手指不小心碰到了梁心兰的手背。

一股电流窜入陆林心间。

大嫂也是一惊，赶忙缩手。

脸上不自觉地泛起一丝红晕。

Page (1/3)

"Uncle, uncle."

"Get up and have some gruel."

The soft female voice woke up Lu Lin from his deep sleep.

My throat was as dry as smoke.

Lu Lin struggled to open his eyes.

In the dim room, a woman wearing a coarse linen skirt was sitting beside the bed, holding a large old porcelain bowl in her hand.

Lu Lin couldn't see her face clearly, so he opened his mouth subconsciously, and a spoonful of gruel flowed down his throat, allowing his body consciousness to gradually return.

Where is this.

Lu Lin remembered that he ran into his ex-girlfriend yesterday. The two had a quick bite and then entered the hotel.

Dry wood and strong fire.

After much tossing, the two of them fell asleep in the middle of the night.

Why did I wake up...

A piece of information appeared in Lu Lin's mind.

Daxia Kingdom, Pingbei County.

His original name was also Lu Lin, and he was just over seventeen years old.

The day before yesterday, I was very hungry. I went into the mountains alone to hunt for some meat. As a result, I got lost in the mountains and froze all night. I was rescued down the mountain by a passing hunter.

After contracting the cold, he lay still in bed for two days and died. Only then did the magpie occupy the dove's nest.

The woman who fed her porridge was her sister-in-law Liang Xinlan.

There is also an eldest brother in the family, Lu Yang.

Speaking of Lu Yang, Lu Lin suddenly felt a lot of resentment coming from his original body.

This guy has nothing to do all day long, either drinking or gambling. If he loses the gambling, he will beat his family members when he gets home.

Sister-in-law Liang Xinlan and the original person are both victims.

The family, which was originally relatively wealthy, has been turned into a mess by Lu Yang in recent years, and it is difficult to even make ends meet.

It's the twelfth lunar month, the weather is freezing, but Lu Lin's family can't even find two kilograms of whole grains.

However, that beast still went out to find people to gamble with peace of mind.

"Sister-in-law, I can do it myself."

After taking two sips of the porridge, Lu Lin felt much better and wanted to drink the porridge by himself.

"No, your body is still weak. Don't move around and let my sister-in-law feed you."

Liang Xinlan's voice was soft and waxy.

It was said to be rejection, but it sounded almost like coquettishness.

At this time, Lu Lin's eyes adjusted to the light in the room.

When he saw Liang Xinlan's face, he couldn't help but be shocked.

So similar.

Liang Xinlan's appearance and temperament were exactly the same as Lu Lin's ex-girlfriend.

Seeing this face, Lu Lin couldn't help but think of last night's experience.

A rush of hot blood rushed to his forehead.

"It's okay, I can do it."

Lu Lin stood up suddenly, grabbed the old porcelain bowl, and accidentally touched the back of Liang Xinlan's hand with his fingers.

An electric current rushed into Lu Lin's heart.

The eldest sister-in-law was also shocked and quickly withdrew her hands.

A blush appeared on his face unconsciously.
